programs.title: The Food That Built The World
programs.desc: An upstart named Oscar Mayer creates one of the most iconic meat brands on the planet. While Jay Hormel invents a meat product sold the world over, which becomes part of a 20-billion-dollar food empire.

programs.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programs.desc: For millennia, there has been speculation about how the world will end. From the detailed account in the Book of Revelation to the prophecies foretold by Nostradamus. Could any of these come true.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Rick takes a trip down the rabbit hole after a seller hops in with a first edition of 'Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.' Can it make Rick grin like the Cheshire Cat, or drive him mad.

programs.title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman
programs.desc: Rene Belbenoit, a petty thief, is captured and sent to France's notorious penal colony in French Guiana. He determines to escape or die trying. His story becomes the basis of several popular movies.

programs.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programs.desc: Welcome to the unreal truth about everyday products of the past that were way more dangerous than meets the unsuspecting eye. Sensational items like mail-order dynamite and radioactive dishes.

programs.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programs.desc: In September 1939, enabled by a secret pact between Adolf Hitler and Josef Stalin, Germany invades Poland with its lightning style of tank warfare, plunging Europe back into war.
